notes.title: Auto Story and New DEMO Game Announcement Coming Soon!!(Patch 1.5.1 Update)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667035/92e6053682467db8151749ca02b9fa6b43904cf8.jpg[/img]
We have 2 exciting news about the Geminiflame universe. The first is that the Geminiflame Alpha Dragon update patch 1.5.1 is now available. The game continues to focus on the player experience and makes it even more fun with the automatic story system. When players unlock a Side story immediately for the first time, a Side story will appear, such as the main story. The reason for updating the system after other updates is because this patch needs to fix the save system first, so you need to update to 1.5.0 first. If you want to see a replay of the Side story, you can check it out in the Document system.

Campaign Mode and Laststand Mode update:
- Update Auto Story System
- Update Save Setting System After players have to save all Option settings in the main game save, it will now be separated to the game save system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667035/43356db721a336d1c6672725fe5a7f467f9a46ab.jpg[/img]

And the second exciting new thing, we now have a new game coming soon, GeminiFlame Hydron's Recipe, a cooking game with mini puzzles mechanic, where you have to help "Hydron" cook and serve food in time, and this game is part of the GeminiFlame Alpha dragon universe. The DEMO of GeminiFlame Hydron's recipe is coming soon, and it needs a little development before everyone can experience it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667035/f7f44587ed09c855148f2ea74461ad93b2394189.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667035/0d3b935b8431a9599a4e9447b9064a19b9829cb5.jpg[/img]

Thank you for supporting Geminiflame Alpha Dragon for the past 2 years and making it this far, and thank you for the new game. The GeminiFlame Hydron's recipe will be coming soon. Details about the DEMO and where and when. " It will be appear when it arrives" >:)

Very exciting. Very exciting. XD
Jaruwit Kraijan
FEB/26/2025

notes.title: Upgrade the Save game system!! (Updated patch 1.5.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667035/ffd032745de4f2380a17fecb9d323e6df0a47524.jpg[/img]
Welcome to the 1.5.0 update GeminiFlame Alpha Dragon, the save system has been upgraded, now there are 5 save slots and you can play 2 modes in a single save slot!!

1. New save system.
After a year of updates, you had to separate your saves between Campaign and Last Stand modes because they had separate side stories and quests that were unlocked separately. But now you can switch between Campaign and Last Stand modes as you wish. Also, you can now share items between the 2 modes!!

2. About sharing system and unlocking Documents between 2 modes
The document system will reward certificates for unlocking skills and money Scales earned after completing quests. In Last Stand mode, if the player is defeated, the system will reset everything and try again, requiring the player to unlock everything again. However, with the 1.5.0 update, after the player resets from the previous save, the document progress will not be lost, and the player will be rewarded with certificates and Scales earned after unlocking documents before starting the first round over!!

3. Weapon item sharing system between 2 modes
For a year now, anyone who has played the game knows that great weapons are available in Campaign mode, such as Armor, Accessories, Shields, and more. In Update 1.5.0, you can purchase weapons from Campaign mode and use them in Last Stand mode via the Inventory!! And in Last Stand mode, you won't lose a weapon in that save slot also.

4.In these 2 modes, food items, ingredient items, items installed on characters, unlocked skills, and many more are still separated.
Since players will use their own skill patterns when playing in Campaign mode, in Last Stand mode, players may need to use other patterns, which means that a lot of player data is not shared between Campign and Last Stand modes. However, we still think about the happiness and fun of players because it is very important. If there is a need to change in the future, this part may be in a future update patch.

5. What about old save before Patch 1.5.0?
Players will still load old saves in the loading screen. When you want to save, you can also save with a new save slot!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667035/2bc7689cad6ead6e2e4663fb6281efc06827023b.jpg[/img]
In conclution, update 1.5.0 brings five new save slots, each of which can be swapped between campaign and last stand modes, and unlocked weapons and documents can be shared, but food items, unlocked skills, materials, and character items are still not shared.

The 1.5.0 update of Gemini Flame Alpha Dragon will lead to future updates, with new stories, new challenges, new items, and new adventures in the future waiting for you!!

Happy new year :)
Jaruwit Kraijan
JAN/14/2025

notes.title: Merry Christmas with a new story, Amei and Cooking battle (Updated patch 1.4G.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667035/66f75cb44762fcfca8c3b3bda8471f800fbc7365.jpg[/img]
Merry Christmas with Update 1.4G.0! The story of "Amei", a new character, and the Adventurer's cooking challenge!! In this match, Mainsolar will have to duel, where both sides must use all of their cooking skills to win the match. If you don't have a game to play this Christmas, enjoy Geminiflame Alpha Dragon! This holiday, don't miss the 1.4G.0 update!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667035/cc8a680406b2c2df4bf677f02d3ffa958e1e9b6c.jpg[/img]
The dish being battled in the 1.4G.0 update is "3 Seasons Mapo Tofu", a legendary recipe from Amei's family, which combines 3 national curries in one dish: Thai Massaman Curry, Chinese Mapo Tofu, and Indian Massala Curry. With their wonderful aroma and abundant herbs and spices, each curry has its own unique characteristics, yet tastes good and goes well with the tofu and itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667035/ad58272c9bc456f6accd1235d9ed9d29ad1773f0.jpg[/img]
This dish has to compete with Mainsolar’s ​​“3 Nations Curry Burger Pie,” which uses curry as a burger and combines 3 national dishes is Italian lasagna, German burgers, and Mexican tortillas (how did he manage to combine all of these?).

Who lost? What did it taste like? what are they fighting for the sake of WHAT!!!
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667035/b971f7454144a78d6b0419e83ad7d4032b65c7ca.jpg[/img]
To unlock this story, go to the village that "Zin" controls and purchase 4 Zin menu items (excluding items from 1.4B.0, 1.4D.0, and 1.4E.0 updates). Namely

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667035/058b478ae03dad8848715708f875554d5d736d1b.jpg[/img]
- Hokkien Mee (หมี่ฮกเกี้ยน : 福建面) It's a local food of Phuket. You can buy it in Zin's Village.
- Mee Hun with Soup (หมี่หุ้นพร้อมซุป : 胡恩面条配汤) It's a local food of Phuket. You can buy it in Zin's Village.
- Moo Hong (หมูฮ้อง : 穆洪) It's a local food of Phuket. You can buy it in Zin's Village.
- Ngo Hiang (โลบะ : 五香滷肉) It's a local food of Phuket. You can buy it in Zin's Village.

Campaign Mode and Laststand Mode update:
- update story "Food of the Zin restaurant, a delicious dish"

Note: Older save versions where the player previously purchased 4 foods will not be able to activate. You must purchase new foods in that old save.

Merry Christmas and Happy New Year (Padoru Padoru ~~~)
Jaruwit Kraijan
DEC/24/2024

notes.title: 8 Gear give Skill and Update Craft Gear!! (Update patch 1.3.3)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667035/04f09b270259883fc8f5c47c74303c7842fc6b37.jpg[/img]
3 month anniversary of the release of our game!! With the 1.3.3 update of Geminiflame Alpha Dragon comes with an unlocked ''Craft'' system which has been locked since version 1.0.0. The reason is that the Gear item is so OP!! What if you had an item with healing skills, stun skills, buff damage? If the Adventurer's skills are similar It will make combination skills boring. And the Geminiflame Alpha Dragon will not be impressed. But now we have a conclusion. Hooray!!!!!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667035/96531d864bbfa117fe03e37c15b82dfc72fb76ba.jpg[/img]
Campain & Last stand Mode update:
1. Unlock Craft Function
2. New Items
- Holy Water (น้ำมนต์  : 圣水) Crafted by Aurora.
Skill : Can revive knocked adventurers and Regen small HP
- Basic Bandage (ผ้าพันแผลเบื้องต้น : 基本绷带) Crafted by Aurora.
Skill : Full Regen HP
- Omega Rune Stone (หินรูน Omega  : 欧米茄符文石) Crafted by Arthid.
Skill : ATK + MATK for 2 turn.
- Theta Rune Stone (หินรูน Theta  : 西塔符文石) Crafted by Arthid.
Skill : DEF + 20 for 2 Turn.
- Herbal Poultice No.1 (ยาพอกแผล No.1 : 草药家禽1号) Crafted by Horizon.
Skill : Full Regen HP
- Mixed Herbal Powder No.1 (ผงสมุนไพรผสม No.1 : 混合草药粉末1号) Crafted by Horizon.
Skill : DEF + 20 for 2 Turn.
-  Herbal Bolus No.1 (ยาสมุนไพรลูกกลอน No.1 : 草药丸1号) Crafted by Lionheart.
Skill : Full Regen HP
- Honest Summon Leaf (ใบขามเสกต่อแตน : 诚实的召唤叶) Crafted by Lionheart.
Skill : Make 1 monster Stun for 1 turn.
All items that you can equip in your tool inventory, such as food or snacks. That creates variety and create your own fighting style!!.

3.New crafting system
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667035/dab02c47bfab439536b7439744a0ae192ef865d6.png[/img]

wait a moment? Why are there so many Gear that can provide full healing? Why and how is this possible? >:)

Jaruwit Kraijan
JAN/17/2024

notes.title: 8 Snack heal TP and update the new crafting system!! (Update patch 1.3.2)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667035/f53c4ab195d0276670b5715fdb9e099097d3e62a.jpg[/img]
Howdy, GF fans and Happy New Year 2024!! Now 1.3.2 update Gemini Flame Alpha Dragon unlocks the "Pestle" new system that was in version 1.0.0 until now. And now you can create a "Snack" to regenerate TP!! So you don't need to "rest" as often anymore. With 8 “snacks” that come with Game Lore that make this game even more fun!! Oops, almost forgot. "I translated all item descriptions into English. :D" Enjoy!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667035/d15442356f20531dc46dfbb4b954d1e42f9217d2.jpg[/img]

Campain & Last stand Mode update:
1. Item's descriptions are now in English.
2. New Items
- Marigold Tea (ชาดอกดาวเรือง) Can crafted by Aurora.
- Flower Cookie (คุ็กกี้ดอกไม้) Can crafted by Aurora.
- Herbal HardTack No.1 (ขนมแท่งสมุนไพร No.1) Can crafted by Arthid.
- Herbal Field Soup No.4 (แกงสมุนไพรสนาม No.4 ) Can crafted by Arthid.
- Jasmine Tea (ชาดอกไม้) Can crafted by Horizon.
- Herbal Khao Jee (ข้าวจี่สมุนไพร) Can crafted by Horizon.
- Hot Slime Syrup (น้ำเชื่อม Slime ต้ม ) Can crafted by Lionheart.
- Khao Tan With Syrup (ข้าวแต๋นราดน้ำเชื่อม) Can crafted by Lionheart.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667035/62f38667626e0ca202d70678098958ad76998b1b.jpg[/img]

3.New crafting system
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667035/b2a99a744a5dcc8420a4dfb95ab96dd0b5932525.jpg[/img]

The "pestle" system was set up in the 1.0.0 game patch after I settled on the idea of item lore not overlapping and it's correlating information between documentation systems. So this patch happened. You can use ingredients in "Trade" or "Forage" or "Hunt" to create "Snacks" for restoring TP. This rule allows you to create your own style according to how you want to play. What? Why is the "Craft" button still there and the list is empty? Is there a legend waiting to be discovered?

What will the next game update be like? >:)

Jaruwit Kraijan
JAN/07/2024

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667035/058b478ae03dad8848715708f875554d5d736d1b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667035/caf37061b9fc6636c2f72983863ccc55d5452cfb.jpg[/img]

And the item description displayed after pressing the Info button is still in Thai. It has not yet been translated into English. Because I don't want to repeat the story of the game between item descriptions and Documentation System and Lore in the future, so I'll rewrite all item descriptions if I must. And I will make all item descriptions follow the same story as the main story. So there was no translation from Thai to English from 1.0.0 until 1.3.1 Pacth. I'm sorry about this. And I wish everyone a happy Christmas and New Year holidays 2024 :)

I'm back. HO HO HO Merry Christmas and Happy New Year 2024 ;D

Jaruwit Kraijan
